node.label: Monocular strabismus
node.definition: A type of strabismus in which the fixating eye is always the same one, while the other eye is constantly deviated. Monocular strabismus is to be distinguished from alternating strabismus, in which either of the eyes 'squints' at different times.

evidence.snippet: Tessadori-van Haaften neurodevelopmental syndrome 3: Monocular strabismus (frequency 1/17) [PCS]
